mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch.console_usage_daily ( stat_date, tenant_id, source, metric_code, page_code, app_version, event_count, success_count, failure_count, last_seen_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{row.statDate}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.source}, #{row.metricCode}, #{row.pageCode}, #{row.appVersion}, #{row.eventCount}, #{row.successCount}, #{row.failureCount}, #{row.lastSeenAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (stat_date, tenant_id, source, metric_code, page_code, app_version) DO UPDATE SET event_count = batch.console_usage_daily.event_count + EXCLUDED.event_count, success_count = batch.console_usage_daily.success_count + EXCLUDED.success_count, failure_count = batch.console_usage_daily.failure_count + EXCLUDED.failure_count, last_seen_at = GREATEST(batch.console_usage_daily.last_seen_at, EXCLUDED.last_seen_at), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
